To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
RXR allosterically activates the LXR binding to ASC-2 by binding to the second ASC-2 LXXLL motif.
RXR allosterically activates the LXR binding to ASC-2 by interacting directly with ASC-2.
RXR allosterically activates the LXR-ASC-2 interaction by binding to the second ASC-2 NR box, NR box-2.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel mechanism of allosterically mediated co-activator function.
the identification of the molecular mechanism of RXR-mediated LXR activation.
the mechanism of allosterically activated LXR transactivation by RXR.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RXR-mediated allosteric activation of the LXR binding to ASC-2 NR box-2 is essential for the LXR transactivating function in vivo.
the ASC-2-LXR-RXR interaction is a unique mechanism of LXR transactivation that is essential for the ASC- 2-mediated transactivation and that is regulated by RXR heterodimer and RXR ligands.
RXR heterodimerized with LXR allosterically regulates the binding of LXR to the second NR-box of ASC-2 and that the ASC-2-LXR interaction is essential for ASC2-mediated transactivation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RXR allosterically activates the LXR-ASC-2 interaction via a unique mechanism involving NR box-2.
RXR allosterically activates the LXR binding to ASC-2 NR box-2.
ASC-2 is an LXR-specific co-activator, which can be activated by RXR in a manner that is independent of RXR binding to ASC-2.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RXR does interact directly with NR-box2, and not NR-box1, of ASC-2 to enhance the LKR-ASC-2 interaction.
RXR can allosterically activate LXR transactivation by binding to ASC-2 and that the NR box- 2 of ASC- 2 is a novel LXR-interacting domain.
the NR box- 2 is the critical domain in ASC-2 that is required for LXR transactivation in vivo, and that this domain interacts with LXR via a unique allosteric regulation by RXR.
